evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on search cost, architecture-ranking quality, model compression, inference latency, peak memory and task accuracy.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括搜索成本、结构排序质量、模型压缩率、推理时延、峰值显存及任务精度。

en.title: Neural Architecture Search and Compression Strategies for Efficient Deployment of Large Models
en.summary: Research on automated architecture search and compression strategies for efficient large-model deployment.
details: The project addresses costly architecture exploration, inefficient search, unstable combinations of compression methods, and limited interpretability. It studies representation mutual-information-based architecture scoring, dynamic-distribution-based search, automated combinations of pruning, quantization and distillation, and information-bottleneck-based explanations of compression.

As principal investigator, I define the scientific questions and overall research plan, design the technical roadmap, organize architecture search, performance estimation and model compression research, and coordinate team responsibilities and intermediate results.
The project is underway and aims to support lower-cost large-model design and efficient deployment through automated optimization under different deployment constraints.

zh.title: 面向大模型高效部署的神经网络结构自动搜索与压缩策略研究
zh.sponsor: 国家自然科学基金面上项目
zh.summary: 围绕大模型高效部署，开展神经网络结构自动搜索与压缩策略研究。
details: 项目针对结构试错成本高、搜索效率低、组合压缩效果不稳定及压缩方法难解释等问题，研究基于表示互信息的架构评分、基于动态分布的结构搜索、剪枝量化蒸馏的多策略自动组合，以及基于信息瓶颈的压缩解释方法。
本人作为项目负责人，负责科学问题凝练、整体研究方案与技术路线设计，组织结构搜索、性能估计和模型压缩研究，并统筹团队分工及阶段成果。
项目正在推进，旨在通过适应不同部署约束的自动优化技术，为大模型低成本设计与高效部署提供方法和技术支撑。

logo.zh: 中国博士后科学基金会

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on search time, candidate evaluation cost, model accuracy and adaptability across tasks.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括搜索耗时、候选结构评估开销、模型精度及跨任务适应性。

en.title: Key Technologies for Neural Architecture Search
en.summary: Postdoctoral research on architecture evaluation, efficient search and task adaptability.
details: The project studies candidate architecture evaluation, search cost and task adaptability, exploring how to discover effective neural architectures with limited computing resources and connect automated machine learning with model efficiency.
As principal investigator, I designed the research plan, studied key methods, organized implementation, and advanced performance estimation and efficient architecture search.
This research developed methods and experience in automated model design, laying a foundation for subsequent architecture search, model compression and efficient large-model deployment research.

zh.title: 神经网络结构搜索关键技术研究
zh.sponsor: 博士后创新人才支持计划
zh.summary: 博士后阶段围绕候选架构评价、高效搜索与任务适应性开展研究。
details: 项目围绕候选架构评价、搜索成本与任务适应性，探索利用有限计算资源发现性能较好的神经网络结构，并将自动机器学习研究与模型轻量化需求相结合。
本人主持项目，负责研究方案设计、关键方法研究与实施安排，推进性能估计和高效结构搜索相关工作。
该阶段研究积累了自动模型设计的方法与经验，为后续结构搜索、模型压缩及大模型高效部署研究奠定基础。

logo.zh: 中国博士后科学基金会

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on supervision requirements, architecture-ranking quality, search cost and accuracy under limited supervision.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括监督数据需求、结构排序质量、搜索成本及有限监督条件下的模型精度。

en.title: Neural Architecture Search with Weak Supervision
en.sponsor: China Postdoctoral Science Foundation, 71st General Funding Round (Second Class)
en.summary: Research on candidate architecture evaluation and selection with limited supervision.
details: The project addresses model design that depends on extensive supervision and costly evaluation. It studies weakly supervised neural architecture search, using limited supervisory information to guide candidate evaluation and selection across different task conditions.

As principal investigator, I formulated the research questions, designed the technical approach and studied the relevant methods, advancing the integration of weakly supervised learning and architecture search.
The work broadened the settings for automated model design and developed architecture search experience under limited supervision, connecting with subsequent efficient model design research.

zh.title: 基于弱监督神经网络结构搜索研究
zh.sponsor: 中国博士后科学基金第71批面上资助二等
zh.summary: 研究利用有限监督信息指导候选网络结构评价与选择的方法。
details: 项目针对模型设计依赖充分监督信息和大量评估计算的问题，研究弱监督条件下的神经网络结构搜索，利用有限监督信息指导候选结构评价与选择，提高自动模型设计对不同任务条件的适应能力。
本人主持项目，负责研究问题凝练、技术方案设计及相关方法研究，推动弱监督学习与结构搜索的结合。
该项工作拓展了自动模型设计的研究场景，积累了有限监督条件下的结构搜索经验，与后续高效模型设计研究形成衔接。

evaluation.en: Technical evaluation spans search efficiency, compression and inference performance under deployment constraints.
evaluation.zh: 技术评价围绕搜索效率、模型压缩效果及部署约束下的推理性能展开。

en.title: Xiamen University Xiaomi Young Scholar Program
en.sponsor: Xiamen University Xiaomi Young Scholar Program
en.summary: Support for research development and team building in automated model design and efficient large-model deployment.
details: The program supports early-career faculty research in artificial intelligence. My research connects automated machine learning, neural architecture search, performance estimation and dynamic-distribution pruning with large-model compression and inference optimization.

As a selected young scholar, I plan research directions, organize research topics and build the team, advance model search, compression and deployment research, and prepare annual research summaries and feedback.
The support helps develop individual algorithm studies into sustained team research, linking earlier methodological work with current demands for efficient large-model applications.

zh.title: 厦门大学小米青年学者项目
zh.sponsor: 厦门大学小米青年学者项目
zh.summary: 支持自动模型设计与大模型高效部署方向的科研发展和团队建设。
details: 项目支持人工智能方向青年教师科研发展。本人将自动机器学习、神经网络结构搜索、性能估计和动态分布剪枝的研究积累延伸至大模型压缩与推理优化。
本人作为获选青年学者，负责研究方向规划、课题组织和团队建设，推进模型搜索、压缩及部署研究，并开展年度成果总结与反馈。
相关支持帮助单项算法探索向持续性团队研究推进，加强前期方法积累与当前大模型高效应用需求之间的联系。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on compression ratio, inference speedup, peak memory and task-accuracy loss.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括压缩率、推理加速比、峰值显存及任务精度损失。

en.title: MindPipe: Automated Large-Model Compression and Quantization
en.summary: I lead development of an automated compression framework for language and vision-language models, connecting core algorithms with GPU and Ascend deployment.
details: The collaboration addresses differing compression sensitivities in multimodal encoders, complex mixture-of-experts optimization and compression-induced changes to cross-modal alignment. It integrates quantization, pruning, distillation, recovery fine-tuning and automated evaluation, with deployment adaptation for GPU and Huawei Ascend environments.

As project leader, I lead the technical roadmap, core compression algorithm design and R&D execution. I drive the integration of quantization, pruning, distillation, evaluation and hardware adaptation into an end-to-end compression framework.

The work aims to provide compression and inference optimization solutions for multimodal large models, reduce repetitive tuning and testing, lower memory and computing requirements, and improve deployment efficiency across computing platforms.

zh.title: MindPipe：大模型自动压缩与量化框架
zh.summary: 本人主导语言与视觉语言模型自动压缩框架研发，将核心算法与GPU、昇腾部署适配打通。
details: 合作针对多模态编码器压缩敏感性不同、混合专家结构优化复杂及跨模态对齐易受压缩影响等问题，将量化、剪枝、蒸馏、恢复微调和自动评测纳入统一工作流，并开展GPU和华为昇腾环境部署适配。
本人作为项目负责人，主导技术路线、核心压缩算法设计及研发执行，推动量化、剪枝、蒸馏、自动评测和硬件适配的端到端集成，负责将算法研究转化为可复用的压缩框架。
相关工作旨在形成多模态大模型压缩与推理优化方案，减少重复调参与测试开销，降低显存和算力需求，提高不同计算平台上的部署效率。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on model size, compiled inference latency, candidate evaluation cost and task accuracy.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括模型体积、编译后推理时延、候选模型评估开销及任务精度。

en.title: Alibaba / Tmall Model Compression and Acceleration
en.summary: Research connecting model compression, compiler optimization and automated architecture search for cloud deployment.
details: The collaboration studies compiler-optimization-driven model design for frequently invoked, latency-sensitive cloud services with complex deployment pipelines. It connects architecture selection with compilation, evaluation and deployment optimization to address the mismatch between theoretical computation cost and actual runtime efficiency.

As project leader, I lead model compression and architecture search development, connect model evaluation with compiler and runtime constraints, and develop the key algorithms for cloud-side model optimization.

The work provides optimization approaches and technical solutions for candidate evaluation and deployment, supporting cloud model systems and helping reduce repeated optimization during evaluation and rollout.

zh.title: 阿里／天猫云端模型压缩与编译加速
zh.summary: 结合模型压缩、编译优化与自动结构搜索，研究云端部署优化。
details: 合作面向高频调用、时延敏感及部署链路复杂的云端业务，研究编译优化驱动的模型设计，将结构选择与编译、评估和部署优化相结合，减少理论计算量与真实运行效率脱节的问题。
本人作为项目负责人，主导模型压缩、自动结构搜索及模型评价方法设计，将算法方案与编译器、运行时约束结合，承担云端模型优化的关键算法研发。
相关工作为候选模型评估和部署提供优化思路与技术方案，支持云端模型系统优化，帮助减少模型评估与上线过程中的重复优化成本。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on computation, parameter count, image quality and mobile execution latency.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括计算量、参数量、重建质量及手机端运行时延。

reported_metrics.en: Compared with representative contemporary methods, computation is reduced 12.5-fold and parameter count is reduced 24.8-fold.
reported_metrics.zh: 相较同期代表性方法，计算量降低12.5倍、参数量降低24.8倍。

en.title: HONOR Smartphone Image Super-Resolution and Enhancement
en.summary: Lightweight image enhancement research balancing reconstruction quality with mobile NPU and ISP constraints.
details: The collaboration develops smartphone image super-resolution and enhancement algorithms under mobile NPU and ISP computing and storage constraints. It combines neural architecture search, dynamic-distribution pruning and hardware-aware compression to explore lightweight networks suited to smartphone execution.
As project leader, I lead lightweight network, architecture search and compression development, addressing the trade-off between reconstruction quality and execution efficiency on mobile hardware.
The work provides lightweight model solutions for smartphone imaging, supports real-time execution and deployment optimization, and helps balance computing resources, storage and response time.

zh.title: 荣耀手机图像超分辨率与轻量化增强
zh.summary: 兼顾图像重建质量与终端NPU、ISP约束，研究轻量化影像增强。
details: 合作围绕手机图像超分辨率与增强，在终端NPU、ISP计算和存储约束下，结合神经网络结构搜索、动态分布剪枝与硬件感知压缩，探索适合手机运行环境的轻量化网络。
本人作为项目负责人，主导轻量化网络、结构搜索与压缩方法设计，解决图像重建质量与手机端执行效率之间的关键算法问题。
相关工作提供手机影像增强的轻量化模型方案，支持实时运行与部署优化，服务于终端算力、存储和响应速度之间的平衡。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on restoration quality, model size, memory use and on-device inference latency.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括图像恢复质量、模型规模、内存占用及终端推理时延。

en.title: vivo Model Compression for Moiré and Shadow Removal
en.summary: I lead lightweight smartphone image restoration research.
details: The collaboration studies how to reduce model size, storage and computation for smartphone moiré and shadow removal while preserving image detail and restoration quality. It combines compression, architecture search and modeling of mobile hardware constraints.
As project leader, I lead compression strategy and hardware-aware optimization development, addressing the key trade-offs between restoration quality, model size and mobile execution cost.
The work provides technical approaches for mobile imaging optimization and improves the feasibility of model execution and engineering deployment in resource-constrained environments.

zh.title: vivo去摩尔纹与去阴影模型轻量化
zh.summary: 主导手机图像恢复模型轻量化研发。
details: 合作面向手机影像去摩尔纹、去阴影任务，研究保留图像细节和处理质量的同时降低模型规模、存储需求和计算开销，结合模型压缩、结构搜索与终端硬件约束建模。
本人作为项目负责人，主导压缩策略与硬件感知优化方法设计，解决图像恢复质量、模型规模和移动端计算开销之间的关键权衡。
相关工作为移动端影像优化提供技术方案，提高模型在资源受限环境中运行和工程部署的可行性。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on recognition and retrieval quality, retrieval latency, tracking stability and real-time execution cost.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标关注识别与检索质量、检索时延、跟踪稳定性及实时运行开销。

en.title: Tencent Youtu Smart Security and Consumer Vision R&D
en.summary: R&D experience in cross-age face recognition, city-scale vehicle retrieval and localization, and real-time face tracking.
details: This work concerns smart security and consumer vision products, addressing age-related recognition challenges, large-scale image and video retrieval and localization, and tracking stability and computing cost in real-time interaction.

As a core algorithm developer, I develop recognition, retrieval and tracking methods and connect efficient training, visual representations and fast retrieval with the requirements of practical vision systems.
The work supports smart security and consumer vision applications and helps translate visual methods from research validation into business systems.

zh.title: 腾讯优图智慧安防与消费级视觉研发
zh.summary: 参与跨年龄人脸识别、城市级车辆检索定位及实时人脸跟踪研发。
details: 研发面向智慧安防与消费级视觉产品，涉及年龄变化带来的识别难度、大规模图像视频的检索定位效率，以及实时交互中的跟踪稳定性与计算开销。
本人作为核心算法开发人员，负责识别、检索和跟踪方法研发，将高效训练、视觉特征表示和快速检索技术用于实际视觉系统。
相关工作为智慧安防和消费级视觉应用提供算法支持，促进视觉方法从研究验证向业务系统应用转化。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on localization accuracy, retrieval latency, feature storage and large-scale matching efficiency.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括定位精度、检索时延、特征存储量及大规模匹配效率。

en.title: DiDi Traffic-Scene Visual Perception and Fast Localization R&D
en.summary: R&D experience in compressed visual fingerprints, scene matching and fast localization.
details: The work studies localization using compressed visual fingerprints for traffic-scene analysis and visual search. It combines fine-grained image matching through local descriptors with large-scale retrieval through global visual fingerprints, while controlling feature storage and search costs.
As a core algorithm developer, I develop compressed visual fingerprints, scene-matching algorithms and fast localization methods, addressing retrieval efficiency and storage constraints.

The work provides approaches for traffic-scene visual retrieval and localization, supporting scene understanding and map data updates with attention to the efficiency and accuracy of large-scale map information processing.

zh.title: 滴滴交通场景视觉感知与快速定位研发
zh.summary: 参与压缩视觉指纹、场景匹配与快速定位研发。
details: 研发面向交通场景分析与视觉搜索，研究基于压缩视觉指纹的定位方法，将局部描述子的精细图像匹配与全局视觉指纹的大规模检索相结合，控制特征存储和搜索开销。
本人作为核心算法开发人员，负责压缩视觉指纹、场景匹配及快速定位方法研发，解决大规模视觉检索的效率与存储约束问题。
相关工作提供交通场景视觉检索与定位方案，支持场景理解和地图数据更新，服务于大规模地图信息处理的效率与准确性需求。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on visual-task quality, model size, memory use and mobile inference latency.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括视觉任务质量、模型体积、内存占用及移动端推理时延。

en.title: OPPO Mobile Vision Algorithms and Lightweight Deployment R&D
en.summary: I lead R&D connecting mobile vision algorithms, compression and hardware adaptation.
details: The work addresses mobile imaging under computing, storage and latency constraints through lightweight visual algorithms, model compression and hardware adaptation. It connects algorithm design with actual device execution conditions to improve practical runtime efficiency.
As project leader, I lead model architecture optimization, compression and deployment development around mobile computing, memory and latency constraints.

The work provides model optimization and deployment approaches for mobile hardware, supports the transition from algorithm validation to device adaptation, and advances lightweight mobile imaging development.

zh.title: OPPO移动端视觉算法与轻量化部署研发
zh.summary: 主导移动端视觉算法轻量化、模型压缩与硬件适配研发。
details: 研发针对手机算力、存储和响应时延限制，开展视觉算法轻量化、模型压缩与硬件适配，将算法设计与终端实际运行条件结合，提高实际运行效率。
本人作为项目负责人，主导面向移动端算力、内存和时延约束的模型结构优化、压缩与部署方法研发。
相关工作提供移动硬件模型优化与部署方案，支持视觉模型从算法验证到终端适配，促进移动影像功能轻量化开发。

en.title: Peng Cheng Cloud Brain Platform Construction and Urgent R&D Tasks
en.summary: Participation in Peng Cheng Cloud Brain platform construction and urgent R&D tasks.
details: I participate in Peng Cheng Cloud Brain platform construction and urgent R&D tasks.
My responsibilities include general task participation and preparation of work summaries and supporting materials.

zh.title: 鹏城云脑建设与应急攻关任务参与
zh.summary: 参与鹏城云脑平台建设与应急攻关任务。
details: 参与鹏城云脑平台建设与应急攻关任务。
相关职责包括一般任务参与，以及阶段工作总结和支撑材料整理。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on model compression, inference speedup and accuracy retention.
evaluation.zh: 技术指标包括模型压缩率、推理加速比及精度保持。

reported_metrics.en: 10B-class LLMs achieve 8-fold compression and 4-fold acceleration; 70B-class LLMs achieve 10-fold compression and 4.5-fold acceleration.
reported_metrics.zh: 10B级LLM实现8倍压缩、4倍加速；70B级LLM实现10倍压缩、4.5倍加速。

en.title: Huawei Large-Model Compression: Automatic Combination of Multiple Compression Strategies
en.summary: Weight sparsification and joint sparse quantization; awarded Huawei's Product-Line-Level Outstanding Collaborative Project.
details: The collaboration develops automatic combinations of model compression strategies, including large-model weight sparsification and joint sparse quantization, to improve efficient inference and deployment.

I contribute project management and original algorithm development. The project received Huawei's Product-Line-Level Outstanding Collaborative Project award; its results were applied to related products and enhanced Ascend product competitiveness.

zh.title: 华为大模型压缩：多压缩策略自动组合优化
zh.summary: 开展大模型权重稀疏化与稀疏量化联合优化，获华为“产品线级优秀合作项目”。
details: 合作围绕大模型权重稀疏化与稀疏量化联合优化，研究多压缩策略自动组合，提升大模型推理与部署效率。
本人承担项目管理与原创算法研发。项目获华为“产品线级优秀合作项目”，相关成果已落地产品，提升了昇腾产品竞争力。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on weight and activation bit widths, accuracy loss and inference bandwidth.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标关注权重与激活量化位宽、精度损失及推理带宽。

en.title: Huawei Automotive BU: Low-Bit Quantization of Multimodal Large Models
en.summary: Collaboration on low-bit quantization and efficient deployment of automotive multimodal large models.
details: The collaboration focuses on low-bit quantization of automotive multimodal large models, addressing inference bandwidth and deployment efficiency through weight and activation quantization and calibration strategies, including PTQ and QAT in PEFT settings.
As project leader, I lead the model quantization collaboration and coordinate technical development.

zh.title: 华为车BU：多模态大模型低比特量化
zh.summary: 围绕车端多模态大模型开展低比特量化与高效部署合作。
details: 合作面向车端多模态大模型的推理带宽与部署效率，研究权重、激活低比特量化及校准策略，涉及PTQ与PEFT场景下的QAT。
本人作为项目负责人，主导模型量化合作与技术协同。

evaluation.en: Evaluation focuses on quantization bit width, accuracy loss relative to the original model, memory use, inference latency and postprocessing latency.
evaluation.zh: 评价指标包括量化位宽、相对原模型的精度损失、内存占用、推理时延及后处理时延。

en.title: Huawei / HiSilicon Quantization-Based AI Model Acceleration for Edge Platforms
en.summary: Joint algorithm and hardware optimization for edge inference adaptation and quantization.
details: The collaboration addresses accuracy degradation, memory constraints and quantization tuning efficiency on resource-constrained edge platforms. It studies model conversion, preprocessing and postprocessing, inference implementation, and on-device accuracy and performance evaluation across vision and selected speech and text tasks.
As project leader, I lead the algorithm and hardware co-design roadmap, organize core quantization and inference development, and drive on-device testing, optimization and delivery reviews.

The collaboration is underway and aims to develop reusable edge inference and quantization optimization approaches, lower model adaptation costs on resource-constrained chips, and improve edge AI application development efficiency.

zh.title: 华为／海思端侧模型量化与推理加速
zh.summary: 围绕端侧推理适配与量化，开展算法和硬件协同优化。
details: 合作针对资源受限端侧平台的精度下降、内存限制与量化调优效率问题，研究模型转换、前后处理、推理实现及板端精度与性能评估，覆盖视觉和部分语音、文本任务。
本人作为项目负责人，主导算法与芯片协同优化的技术路线，组织核心量化与推理算法研发，推动板端测试、性能优化及交付评审。
合作正在推进，旨在形成可复用的端侧推理与量化优化方案，降低模型在小算力芯片上的适配成本，提高端侧AI应用开发效率。
